invalid_journey.title: Invalid SNCF journey: {title}
invalid_journey.description:
The SNCF API rejects this journey: "{reason}".

As configured it can never return a train (unknown station, date outside published timetables…). Delete it and create it again, choosing a **station** for departure and arrival, in Settings → Devices & services → SNCF Trains.

api_unavailable.title: SNCF API unreachable
api_unavailable.description:
Several consecutive updates failed (last journey: {title}). The last known data is still displayed.

Check Home Assistant's Internet connection and the service status at https://www.digital.sncf.com/startup/api. This message clears itself once the API responds again.

quota_exceeded.title: SNCF API quota exceeded
quota_exceeded.description:
The SNCF API rejects requests: your key's quota (5,000 requests per day) is used up (last journey: {title}). The last known data is still displayed.

Reduce the number of journeys or increase the update interval in the integration options. This message clears itself when the quota resets.
